segments.title: 第114章 十年老粉
segments.content:
Reigniting the Verdant Years, Chapter 114: A Ten-Year Fan

As the week progressed to Saturday, although the specific scores for each subject had not yet been announced, the teachers had already gone over the exam papers in class.

So everyone had a rough idea of what they scored.

Even so, finding out exactly how many points a classmate got was still quite a difficult task.

The more honest ones would tell you their specific score.

The more cunning ones would sigh and lament, insisting they bombed the test.

But you never knew if they really bombed it or not.

An honest person might offer some words of comfort, while the more experienced would watch coldly from the sidelines, refusing to believe it until they saw the actual score.

After all, some people were truly devious; examples of those who claimed to have failed while ranking in the top three or ten of the class were everywhere.

Such academic phonies were even more detestable than straightforward top students.

But Li Luo was different. Thanks to his memory palace, he remembered every answer he wrote on his exam paper with perfect clarity.

So he already had an exact number for his score.

With this confidence, he walked with a vigorous stride.

"Everyone, settle down. After the morning self-study session ends, it will be time for the parent-teacher conference." Kong Junxiang arrived in the classroom early in the morning, holding a large stack of file folders, which he placed on the lecturer's desk.

After the classroom quieted down, Kong Junxiang said, "During today's morning self-study, we'll do three things."

"First, come and get these file folders."

With that, Kong Junxiang picked up a file folder, glanced at the name written on it, and called out, "Wei Chun."

Hearing his name, Wei Chun quickly stood up and went to the front to get his file folder.

Names were called out one by one, and everyone queued up to receive their folders. During this, Xu Yinghuan asked curiously, "Teacher Kong, what's inside these?"

"Your exam papers," Kong Junxiang said with a smile. "The exam scores are inside, along with some materials for the parent-teacher conference. These are all things we'll be using in a bit."

"Huh?" Xu Yinghuan paused, then couldn't help but ask, "Can we take a look first?"

"These are all sealed with a strip. If you want to see your scores, wait until the conference starts, then go look at the bulletin board on the first floor," Kong Junxiang said with a smile. "They should be updating the ranking lists right about now."

"Teacher Kong, I need to go to the restroom!" Zhu Yufei immediately raised his hand.

"Hold it." Kong Junxiang shot him a look. "You can go look later, it's not going anywhere. Don't be so impatient."

After everyone had received their file folders, Kong Junxiang distributed a letter to each person and said, "I'm giving you ten minutes. Each of you, write a letter to your parents, then place it on your desk along with the file folder."

Li Luo took the envelope and fiddled with it in his hands, then glanced curiously at Yan Zhusheng beside him.

Yan Zhusheng was already writing her letter. Noticing Li Luo's gaze, she silently raised a hand to block his view. "No peeking."

"What did you write? Let me use it as a reference."

Yan Zhusheng shook her head. "Think for yourself."

"Fine." Li Luo sighed. He felt like he didn't have much to say to his dad. Twirling his pen, he pondered for a moment before finally starting to write.

After everyone had finished their letters, Kong Junxiang said, "The last thing is your arrangements for the parent-teacher conference."

"Those of you in clubs should have received a notice from your clubs this week, right?"

"After the parent-teacher conference in the classroom is over, the parents of our grade will tour the school's club activities."

"So when your parents arrive, you will go to your respective activity rooms and prepare according to your club's arrangements."

"If you haven't joined any clubs, you'll go to the classroom on the sixth floor for a self-study session, which will serve as a demonstration. Parents will also visit and observe."

"For now, wait in the classroom. When your parents arrive, give them your seats."

"Is everyone clear?" Seeing everyone nod, Kong Junxiang gave a satisfied nod, his gaze turning to Li Luo and Shi Yanran.

"The student council still needs to organize and guide the parents into the school, right? You can go over now. When you're done, Li Luo, remember to come back."

Li Luo nodded, stood up, and headed towards the school gate with Shi Yanran.

Before 7:30 in the morning, parents had already started arriving at the school gate one after another.

However, the bell for the end of morning self-study hadn't rung yet, so the security guards kept the gates closed.

Members of the student council had already gathered there. Under a temporary sunshade set up outside the school gate yesterday, they invited early-arriving parents to cool down and handed out herbal tea.

Li Luo and Shi Yanran were among them.

"Li... Li Luo?"

Just as Li Luo was handing tea to a parent, a familiar voice came from the side.

Li Luo turned his head and saw his maternal great-aunt, Zhang Xuefen.

Upon seeing Li Luo, Zhang Xuefen slowly walked over, took a cup of herbal tea from Li Luo's hand, and looked him up and down. "I heard from your cousin that you're the class president now? You've really made something of yourself."

Li Luo nodded, not really wanting to deal with her, but he still greeted her politely, "Hello, Great-Aunt."

"Mm," Zhang Xuefen nodded with a smile and then said, "Your grades should be pretty good now. Our Little Chun said you got 14th in the class on the last start-of-term exam, right?"

"But you're the class president, after all. You still need to keep working hard. You should at least aim for the top ten in the class, right? You have to set an example."

"Oh, right, did your family buy you an apartment in that complex nearby?"

"Sigh... I don't know what to say about your parents. It's so remote around Fuyi High School. What were they thinking, taking on a mortgage to buy a place here, just to take it off someone else's hands."

"The mortgage is for thirty years. Right now, your parents can help you pay it, but once you start working, you'll have to carry that burden yourself."

"Or maybe you'll sell this one to buy a new one? It's hard to say what will happen then. Who knows how much money you'll lose."

Zhang Xuefen chattered on, but her point was singular: since your family didn't invest in their project and instead bought a house here, you've definitely taken a huge loss.

Li Luo was speechless. He sighed and said, "Great-Aunt, I still have to greet the other parents. Please excuse me."

After moving a bit farther away from Zhang Xuefen, Li Luo finally felt some peace and quiet in his ears.

Some relatives are just like that, always hoping you're doing a bit worse off. The more miserable you are, the more comfort they can derive from feeling superior.

Li Luo couldn't be bothered to argue.

He just hoped Zhang Xuefen wouldn't be too jealous when the property prices here skyrocketed in the future.

As he was thinking this, a familiar car drove past the school gate and parked in a nearby spot.

Soon after, Li Luo saw two figures he couldn't be more familiar with.

But before Li Luo could go over to greet them, the student council leader, Xu Youyu, had already approached them with a smile, handing them two cups of tea.

"Hello, Uncle and Auntie," Xu Youyu said politely. "The school gate will open in a few more minutes. We'll have to ask you to wait here a little longer."

"Oh, that's no problem." Lin Xiuhong took the tea and asked curiously, "Is your father or your mother coming today?"

"My mother will be coming," Xu Youyu replied with a smile. "Oh, by the way, my mom wanted to invite you, Uncle and Auntie, to lunch today. I'm not sure if Li Luo mentioned it."

"Oh, that." Lin Xiuhong nodded. "Li Luo told us. That's fine, but we should be the ones treating. After the parent-teacher conference, let's buy some groceries and go to the Bihai Lanting apartment to cook a nice meal for you."

"Okay, that sounds great," Xu Youyu nodded and started chatting casually with Lin Xiuhong.

Beside them, Li Guohong scanned the crowd of students. Seeing Li Luo, he walked over to his son and asked for directions to Class Eight.

Meanwhile, Lin Xiuhong couldn't find Ying Chanxi, so she asked Xu Youyu, "Which way is Class One?"

"Huh?" Xu Youyu was taken aback for a moment and couldn't help but remind her, "Auntie, Li Luo is in Class Eight."

"I know." Lin Xiuhong nodded with a smile. "I'm not here for his parent-teacher conference. It's just that Xixi's father had something come up and couldn't make it, so I'm attending the meeting for him."

"Oh, I see," Xu Youyu said, a look of realization on his face, before giving her the directions to Class One.

With two or three minutes left before the school gate opened, Li Guohong stood next to Li Luo, asking him about the parent-teacher conference.

After chatting for a bit, he got bored and started humming a song casually under the sunshade.

Hearing the familiar melody, Li Luo couldn't help but give his dad a strange look. "What are you humming? Is that 'Fluttering Like a Dream'?"

"Yo? You know it?" Li Guohong raised an eyebrow.

"Of course I know it... but Dad, you listen to new songs?"

"What do you know?" Li Guohong huffed. "This is Yuan Wanqing's new song. She was already super popular back in 2001. Your dad has been a ten-year fan."

"...How come I never knew that." Li Luo's mouth twitched.

"There's a lot you don't know," Li Guohong chuckled. "Young people's tastes are different from ours now. I think her new song is pretty good."

"It is good," Li Luo nodded. "But during the parent-teacher conference later, Dad, please don't shout."

"What do you mean by that?"

"Nothing, I'm just worried my results will give you a shock."

A short while later, the bell for the end of morning self-study rang, and the security guard opened the school gate.

The parents who had arrived early began to enter the campus, guided by student council members toward their respective classrooms.

Li Luo glanced at his parents, then at Zhang Xuefen who had sidled up to them. Hearing her repeat the same speech she had given him earlier, he rolled his eyes.

A few more minutes passed before Ying Chanxi arrived late, finding Li Luo at the school gate.

"Have your uncle and auntie arrived?"

"They're already inside." Li Luo pointed at the gate and then asked, "Why are you so late?"

"Teacher Sun got angry," Ying Chanxi said helplessly. "On this midterm exam, more than ten people in our class didn't make it into the top forty, and some even dropped out of the top one hundred. He gave them a harsh scolding."

"Did he scold you?"

"Do you think that's possible?" Ying Chanxi shot him a look.

The two chatted as they greeted the parents who arrived subsequently.

Soon, it was almost eight in the morning.

Ying Chanxi said goodbye to Li Luo and headed back to her classroom to prepare to receive the parents there.

The class presidents of the other classes also left one by one, leaving only the Youth League Secretaries to wait for any late parents.

Li Luo was about to leave as well.

But just then, a low-profile car stopped at the school gate. A woman in a pale yellow dress, wearing a mask and sunglasses, with long, curled hair, walked gracefully toward the entrance.

Even though she was well-disguised, Li Luo recognized her with just one glance.

"Hello, Auntie," Li Luo stepped forward to greet her. "I'm Li Luo from Class Eight. You must be Yan Zhusheng's mother, right?"

Hearing the boy's words, Yuan Wanqing immediately paused. Her eyes, hidden behind sunglasses, narrowed slightly as she instinctively looked Li Luo up and down.

"Yes, hello." Yuan Wanqing gave a slight nod. "Thank you for taking care of Shengsheng all this time."

"You're welcome." Li Luo smiled. "I was just about to head back to the classroom, so I can take you there."

"Okay, I'll have to trouble you then."

(End of Chapter)
